content: The use of car-speak is present throughout the car-buying process. It begins in the Research Phase where buyers identify their needs BIBREF0. When the buyer goes to a dealership to buy a car, they communicate with the dealer in similar car-speak BIBREF2 and convey their needs to the sales representative. Finally, the sales representative uses their internal classifier to translate this car-speak into actual physical attributes (e.g. `fast' $ \longrightarrow $ `700 horsepower & a sleek form factor') and offers a car to the buyer.
